sources.title: miniFE proxy application
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。

related.title: PETSc CG：殘差、誤差與停止條件
related.titleEn: PETSc CG: residuals, errors and stopping criteria
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付stencil依賴、穩定判準與雙緩衝反例；.4/.6可重算，接受前者且以明示穩定理由拒絕後者；請另一位學徒依交付件重新推導一組；未通過或資料不足必須明記，不以品牌或峰值取代證據。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver stencil dependencies, stability criteria and double-buffer counterexamples. Reproduce 0.4/0.6, accept the former and reject the latter using the stated bound. Have another learner derive one case from the handover; label failures or missing evidence without substituting brand names or peak rates.
related.difference: 列Ax、r=b−Ax和精確解[1,1]，分別畫殘差與解誤差兩欄；兩比值正確，第一案不過.01、第二案通過；明示這是教學門檻。
related.differenceEn: List Ax, r = b − Ax, and the exact solution [1, 1]. Keep residual and solution-error columns separate. Both ratios match; first fails 0.01, second passes, and the threshold is labeled instructional.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: u新_i=u_i+r(u左−2u_i+u右)，r=κΔt/Δx²；一維等距顯式擴散的常見穩定限制r≤1/2；合成κ1、Δx.1，Δt.004對.006；先只計r，不外推多維；名義式 1*.004/.1**2 = 0.4 dimensionless r；變更式 1*.006/.1**2 = 0.6 dimensionless r。數據與驗收門檻為原創教學情境，並非所列超級電腦或函式庫的實測規格。

相對殘差ρ=||b−Ax||₂/||b||₂；CG另需適合的對稱正定問題，不能忽略矩陣條件；合成A=diag(2,4)，b=[2,4]，x=[.9,1]；變更x=[.99,1]；名義式 .2/sqrt(20) = 0.04472135955 relative residual；變更式 .02/sqrt(20) = 0.004472135955 relative residual。數據與驗收門檻為原創教學情境，並非所列超級電腦或函式庫的實測規格。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: u_new=u_i+r(u_left−2 u_i+u_right), r=kappaDt/Dx²; the one-dimensional uniform explicit diffusion bound is r≤1/2. Synthetic kappa 1, Dx = 0.1, Dt = 0.004 versus 0.006; compute r only without multidimensional extrapolation. Nominal 1*.004/.1**2 = 0.4 dimensionless r; changed 1*.006/.1**2 = 0.6 dimensionless r. Inputs and acceptance thresholds are original teaching scenarios, not measured specifications of the named systems or libraries.

Relative residual rho=||b−Ax||₂/||b||₂; CG also requires suitable symmetric-positive-definite systems. Synthetic A=diag(2, 4), b [2, 4], x [.9, 1] then [.99, 1]. Nominal .2/sqrt(20) = 0.04472135955 relative residual; changed .02/sqrt(20) = 0.004472135955 relative residual. Inputs and acceptance thresholds are original teaching scenarios, not measured specifications of the named systems or libraries.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: HPL：稠密基準的記憶體與問題規模
related.titleEn: HPL: dense-benchmark memory and problem size
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付stencil依賴、穩定判準與雙緩衝反例；.4/.6可重算，接受前者且以明示穩定理由拒絕後者；請另一位學徒依交付件重新推導一組；未通過或資料不足必須明記，不以品牌或峰值取代證據。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver stencil dependencies, stability criteria and double-buffer counterexamples. Reproduce 0.4/0.6, accept the former and reject the latter using the stated bound. Have another learner derive one case from the handover; label failures or missing evidence without substituting brand names or peak rates.
related.difference: 畫主矩陣、右手邊及工作區三類，單獨記分散區塊，不把主矩陣值當峰值記憶體；兩容量正確、來源與合成輸入分開，速度結論僅來自有效完成的跑次。
related.differenceEn: Separate main matrix, right-hand side, and workspace. Include distributed blocks; main-matrix storage is not peak memory. Both capacities must match. Separate sourced context from teaching inputs and base speed claims only on valid completed runs.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: u新_i=u_i+r(u左−2u_i+u右)，r=κΔt/Δx²；一維等距顯式擴散的常見穩定限制r≤1/2；合成κ1、Δx.1，Δt.004對.006；先只計r，不外推多維；名義式 1*.004/.1**2 = 0.4 dimensionless r；變更式 1*.006/.1**2 = 0.6 dimensionless r。數據與驗收門檻為原創教學情境，並非所列超級電腦或函式庫的實測規格。

FP64 n×n主矩陣容量8n² bytes，未含右手邊、pivot、工作區及分散儲存padding；合成n10000對20000，單位GiB以2^30換算；名義式 8*10000**2/2**30 = 0.745058059692 GiB main matrix；變更式 8*20000**2/2**30 = 2.98023223877 GiB main matrix。數據與驗收門檻為原創教學情境，並非所列超級電腦或函式庫的實測規格。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: u_new=u_i+r(u_left−2 u_i+u_right), r=kappaDt/Dx²; the one-dimensional uniform explicit diffusion bound is r≤1/2. Synthetic kappa 1, Dx = 0.1, Dt = 0.004 versus 0.006; compute r only without multidimensional extrapolation. Nominal 1*.004/.1**2 = 0.4 dimensionless r; changed 1*.006/.1**2 = 0.6 dimensionless r. Inputs and acceptance thresholds are original teaching scenarios, not measured specifications of the named systems or libraries.

A main FP64 n×n matrix requires 8 n² bytes, excluding the right-hand side, pivots, workspace, and distribution padding. Synthetic n = 10000 versus 20000. Convert bytes to GiB by dividing by 2^30. Nominal 8*10000**2/2**30 = 0.745058059692 GiB main matrix; changed 8*20000**2/2**30 = 2.98023223877 GiB main matrix. Inputs and acceptance thresholds are original teaching scenarios, not measured specifications of the named systems or libraries.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
